{{Quote|Gearshift!|This troopers last words|<ref name="LoT" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' was part of the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] and ventured to the catacombs of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]. He was ordered to return to the surface by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] with fellow [[Gearshift/Legends|trooper Gearshift]] to get a signal and call General [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] for reinforcements, but the two were ambushed and killed by [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They aren't going down."<br />"We have to to turn back!|This clone with Gearshift fighting undead Geonosians|<ref name="LoT" />}}
[[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on the water world of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the trooper was assigned to the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In late [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he fought in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]. During the battle, General [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and another [[Buzz/Legends|clone]] went to hunt the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], and lost communications in a sandstorm at the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]]. After the sandstorm cleared, Cody, Obi Wan, and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] assembled a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] group to go hunt for them which this trooper was a part of.<ref name="LoT" />

[[File:Saving-Gearshift.jpg|thumb|225px|This clone trying to save Gearshift]]
Arriving at the temple, they found [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz's]] body and [[Luminara's lightsaber/Legends|Luminara Unduli's lightsaber]]. The team then entered the catacombs of the temple, and not long after they entered, they encountered a group Geonosian [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]]. The clones and the Jedi narrowly escaped; deciding they needed reinforcements, they sent the trooper and a clone named [[Gearshift/Legends|Gearshift]] to get help from [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. After heading out to the surface, the two clones were surrounded and killed by zombies, and their bodies were later found by the Jedi and remaining clones.<ref name="LoT" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Wind's playing tricks on us, right?"<br />"Look around there's nothing [...] What the?"<br />"Blast them!"|This clone and Gearshift right before being confronted by Geonosian zombies|<ref name="LoT" />}}
Like all Jango Fett clones, this clone stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. When his companion Gearshift got attacked and pulled into the air, this clone tried to save him and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="LoT" />

==Equipment==
This clone wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with orange markings representing his [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]. He utilized a standard [[DC-15A blaster carbine]].<ref name="LoT" />
